levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: Several items are placed in the wrong light or dark pile, or sorting appears based on fabric type or size instead of color.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: All ten items are placed in the correct light or dark pile based on color.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: All ten items are correctly sorted, and the learner correctly explains the reasoning for at least one multi-colored item.

levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: A brand-new deeply colored item is placed directly into the dark pile instead of the 'might still bleed dye' spot.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Any brand-new deeply colored item is correctly set aside in the 'might still bleed dye' spot.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: The 'might still bleed dye' item is set aside correctly, and the learner explains the specific reason it cannot go straight into the dark pile.

lookFors: The learner names color, not fabric or size, when describing a sorting decision.
The reflection response names one specific item that moved piles, not a general statement about the whole sort.

nonDiagnosticGuard: Do not infer effort, motivation, diagnosis, or character from an error.
